skill.name: security-report
skill.description: Generate structured DOCX security assessment reports with findings, risk ratings, remediation timelines, and executive-ready sections.
skill.summary: Create DOCX security assessment reports with findings, risk ratings, and remediation guidance.
skill.author: BytR-Ecosystems

content.value_statement: Security findings are hard to present clearly to executives and technical teams. This skill creates structured DOCX reports with risk ratings and remediation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates a standard DOCX security assessment report structure.
Organizes findings by severity with risk rating colors.
Includes executive summary, methodology, detailed findings, and appendices sections.
Defines a findings table with evidence, CVSS, remediation, and references fields.
Adds remediation roadmap guidance for prioritized follow-up work.
limitations: Does not perform vulnerability scanning or exploit validation.
Requires the user to provide accurate findings, evidence, and scope details.
Does not include embedded templates or automated chart generation.
References advanced files that may not be included in this package.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Penetration Test Report
use_cases.description: Turn confirmed findings into a client-ready document with severity order, evidence, and remediation details.

use_cases.title: Summarize Internal Audit Results
use_cases.description: Create a structured report for leadership that explains risk, business impact, and remediation priorities.

use_cases.title: Document Compliance Gaps
use_cases.description: Convert control gaps into a clear assessment document with ownership, timelines, and supporting references.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a small findings list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX security assessment report from these findings. Include an executive summary, risk summary, detailed findings, and remediation roadmap.

prompt_templates.title: Format Findings by Severity
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a vulnerability assessment report. Sort findings by severity, apply risk colors, and include evidence, impact, remediation, and references for each item.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Executive Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a security report for executive stakeholders. Keep the summary concise, explain business risk, and provide a phased remediation timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Compliance Gap Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with controls and remediation owners.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a compliance gap analysis report. Map each gap to the affected control, owner, business impact, remediation action, and target completion date.

output_examples.input: A penetration test found three high-risk issues and five medium-risk issues.
output_examples.output: A DOCX report with an executive summary, severity-ranked findings, evidence sections, and a remediation roadmap.

output_examples.input: An audit team needs a leadership summary for unresolved security gaps.
output_examples.output: A concise assessment document that explains business risk, priority actions, and recommended completion timelines.

output_examples.input: A compliance review identified missing access controls and logging gaps.
output_examples.output: A gap analysis report with control references, affected systems, remediation owners, and follow-up dates.

best_practices: Provide verified findings with evidence, affected assets, and business impact.
Use consistent severity criteria before generating the report.
Review the final DOCX for client names, scope limits, and sensitive details.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent findings or evidence.
Do not mix unverified scanner output with confirmed vulnerabilities without labels.
Do not publish reports before checking confidential data and recipient scope.

faq.question: Does this skill scan systems for vulnerabilities?
faq.answer: No. It formats findings and recommendations into a security report. Users must provide the assessment data.

faq.question: What file format does it target?
faq.answer: It targets DOCX reports using python-docx style document generation guidance.

faq.question: Can it include CVSS scores?
faq.answer: Yes. The report structure includes severity and CVSS fields for each detailed finding.

faq.question: Is it suitable for executive audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an executive summary and risk summary designed for non-technical stakeholders.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include remediation planning?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes remediation recommendations and a roadmap section for prioritized action.
